World-class agency editorial photography, the visual standard of a top global creative agency's own website: sophisticated, modern, clean, deliberately art-directed like a high-end magazine feature and the pristine sets of top US marketing podcasts. Shot on a medium-format camera, impeccable craft, natural true-to-life color, rich clean blacks, no filter, no teal-and-orange grade, no HDR. The COLOR comes from the SET DESIGN, not from clothing: wardrobe is tailored and textured in quiet neutrals (cream, oatmeal, charcoal, warm grey, camel) so the room carries the color; NO blue clothing, NO uniforms, NO logos. Casting: Latin American professionals with distinct, natural, non-model faces and varied ages. Nobody looks at the camera; no stock smiles, no handshakes. Uncluttered, every object curated. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no neon signs anywhere.

POINT OF VIEW (essential): taken from the CLIENT'S OWN SEAT, lens only a few centimeters behind the near edge of the table and just above its surface. FOREGROUND (planned): the near edge of the table is so close to the lens that it renders as a strongly out-of-focus soft band across the ENTIRE width of the bottom 13% of the frame, with a soft blurred edge; the tabletop gradually comes into focus toward the people; nothing on that near edge. The upper quarter is calm, out-of-focus architecture. Vertical 4:5.

SCENE — "Ink studio" meeting room: walls in deep ink blue lacquer (the color #022A4E to #023C70, a very deep midnight blue, NOT black), a slate-grey (#263448 to #505964) upholstered banquette, a dark walnut table, brushed brass details, one tall window on the left giving soft directional daylight that models the faces, and one warm brass lamp glowing in the background. ONE small accent object in vivid energy orange (#F55D01) — a single ceramic vase on the credenza behind them, small in frame. A woman strategist in her forties explains with an open-hand gesture over printed sheets; a younger man listens and takes notes. 80mm lens at f/2, focus on her eyes. The near edge of the table is dark walnut in shadow, rendered as a DARK soft band.
